exposure: Idea of control of body and life
outcome: Discourse about the decision on childbirth
Perception and experience of cesarean delivery as a controlled birth practice
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean surgery in private hospitals in the metropolitan areas of Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo, Brazil.
finding: The idea of control, encompassing elements like pain, body integrity, risk control, birth aesthetics, and social and reproductive times, is central to the discourse surrounding cesarean delivery as a birth practice, and is exercised through interaction networks involving women, family, professionals, technological objects, and institutions.
mod_finding: The study reveals how the idea of control, encompassing various factors, shapes the discourse and practice of cesarean delivery among women in private healthcare settings.
